intro.title: Star Rating Component
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Star Rating Component that allows users to select a rating from one to five stars. You will learn how to use Angular's component structure and data binding to display interactive stars. The core programming concept involves handling user input events to update the component's state and reflect the selected rating visually. You will work with TypeScript for logic, Angular templates for the UI, and CSS for styling the stars. By the end, you'll have a functional component that can be integrated into any Angular application to collect user feedback.
intro.usecase: Star rating components are a fundamental UI pattern for collecting and displaying user feedback across countless applications. You'll implement them in e-commerce product pages, like on Amazon or eBay, to allow customers to rate items they've purchased. They are also essential in service review platforms, such as Yelp or TripAdvisor, where users rate restaurants or hotels, and in media apps like Netflix or Goodreads for rating movies or books. As a developer, you'll build these interactive components to enhance user engagement and provide valuable data for your application's analytics and recommendations.
